parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values: false. Currently, only false is supported, which indicates that the capacity reservation is directly released without a dry run.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id
parameters.description: The ID of the capacity reservation.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the capacity reservation. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
